name: gate-keeper-glossary
source: The Gate-Keeper product glossary (Doc 15) and the name-form convention decided by the owner on 28 October 2026.

terms.definition: A signed bundle of detection rules that the scanner loads as data rather than as engine code. Each rule carries a citation to the law or directive it enforces and the corpus cases that exercise it.
The measured state of a repository's handling of personal data, reported as open findings by severity over time, exception counts and ages, and rule-pack freshness.
The annual plan that adds new rule packs and new major versions while it is active.

nameForms.usedFor: The product and trademark in prose, user-interface copy and titles.
GitHub repositories, package names, Docker images and folder names. This covers the Maven Central artefacts and any Composer package names for the PHP middleware on the roadmap.
.NET namespaces and NuGet package identifiers, and C# and Kotlin type names.
Domains, the command-line binary, the licence product claim, and environment variables (written in upper case).
